observations: The two floor search windows show ribbed, approximately sheet-like visible surfaces; no interior surface or material is identified.
The central route window shows a long lower surface; its rendering does not reveal the tunnel interior or prove shift-linkage clearance.
Sill and transition windows include mixed body-adjacent surfaces and assembled mechanical components; they are not accepted part masks.
The side view shows incomplete upper-body coverage. The six cuts retain open scan intersections; no cabin enclosure is inferred.
The central-floor image intentionally crops the front and rear assemblies; the whole-underbody view supplies context.
All four inspection cameras and the four quarter-orbit decoded frames differ. The movie shows an underbody orbit rather than a frozen first frame.

rejected_attempts.reason: Camera changes did not refresh the render; all four still images were identical. Exact scan geometry passed the separate checker, but media were rejected.

files_committed: Source, settings, aggregate results and hashes only; scan-derived USD, arrays and images remain private.
